supplements.title: Physalin A Suppresses Human Oral Squamous Carcinoma Cell Migration and Invasion Through Inhibiting Grb2/Ras and MMP/uPA Signaling Pathways.
supplements.summary: Physalin A, a natural compound, reduces oral cancer cell migration and invasion by blocking specific cellular signaling pathways.

supplements.title: Methionine Restriction Alone Induces T-cell-mediated Immunotherapy of Osteosarcoma in a Syngeneic Mouse Model.
supplements.summary: Restricting methionine alone effectively triggers the immune system to fight osteosarcoma in mice without additional treatments.

supplements.title: Mechanistic Studies of Anticancer Effects of Salicylaldehyde Benzoylhydrazone in 2D/3D Lung Cancer Cell Cultures.
supplements.summary: Salicylaldehyde benzoylhydrazone shows anticancer activity against lung cancer cells in both 2D and 3D culture models.

supplements.title: Cardioprotective and anti-inflammatory properties of blood flow restriction training in older or high-risk cardiovascular disease population: systematic review and meta-analysis.
supplements.summary: Blood flow restriction training combined with aerobic exercise safely improves heart health and reduces inflammation in elderly and high-risk cardiovascular patients.

supplements.title: Melittin Acts as a Radiosensitizer for Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer by Inhibiting the DNA Damage Repair System and Inducing Apoptosis.
supplements.summary: Melittin from bee venom makes lung cancer cells more vulnerable to radiation therapy by blocking their DNA repair abilities.

supplements.title: Reduced Versus Oxidized NAD+ Precursors Drive Distinct Transcriptomic, Proteomic, and Metabolic Profiles in Hepatocytes.
supplements.summary: Reduced NAD+ precursors boost cellular NAD+ levels more potently than standard versions and trigger broader metabolic changes in liver cells.

supplements.title: Germacrone Alleviates Cisplatin-Induced Nephrotoxicity by Activating PI3K/Akt Signaling, Inhibiting Ras/MAPK Signaling, and Regulating Macrophage Polarization.
supplements.summary: Germacrone protects kidneys from cisplatin chemotherapy damage without reducing the drug's cancer-fighting effects in breast cancer.

supplements.title: Koumine from Gelsemium elegans Benth suppresses colorectal cancer metastasis by inhibiting vasculogenic mimicry formation through epithelial-mesenchymal transition and cytoskeleton remodeling.
supplements.summary: Koumine, a plant compound, stops colorectal cancer spread by blocking abnormal blood vessel formation and preventing cancer cells from becoming mobile.

supplements.title: Dose-dependent biphasic reversal of ABC transporter-mediated multidrug resistance by natural dihydrochalcone via P-glycoprotein suppression.
supplements.summary: A natural compound from plants suppresses P-glycoprotein to reverse drug resistance in cancer cells at specific doses.

supplements.title: Flavonoid diversity across six Ocimum accessions: UPLC-MS/MS metabolomics and RNA-seq reveal anticancer leads and nutraceutical potential.
supplements.summary: Three flavonoid compounds from Ocimum plants show promise against cancer by targeting multiple cancer-related proteins and pathways.

supplements.title: Mechanistic insights into the antioxidant activity of sorghum bran phenolics via compositional profiling, network pharmacology and molecular docking.
supplements.summary: Sorghum bran's phenolic compounds may fight cancer by blocking the PI3K-AKT signaling pathway through interactions with key cancer-related proteins.

supplements.title: Electroacupuncture combined with fruquintinib and sintilimab in microsatellite-stable metastatic colorectal cancer: A phase II study.
supplements.summary: Electroacupuncture combined with two cancer drugs improved tolerability while maintaining effectiveness against treatment-resistant colorectal cancer.

supplements.title: Evaluation of the mechanism underlying melatonin action in cholestatic liver disease treatment via network pharmacology, molecular docking, and in vivo experiments.
supplements.summary: Melatonin reduces inflammation and fibrosis in cholestatic liver disease by modulating MMP9 and EGFR/AKT signaling pathways.

supplements.title: Skeletal Diversity of Diterpenoids Isolated from the Soft Coral Sclerophytum heterospiculatum in Kikai Island.
supplements.summary: Researchers isolated five new compounds from soft coral that showed cytotoxic activity against human cancer cell lines.

supplements.title: Farnesol Targets the GSTP1/MAPK Axis to Inhibit Trauma-Induced Tendon Heterotopic Ossification.
supplements.summary: Farnesol, a natural compound, prevents abnormal bone formation in injured tendons by blocking the GSTP1/MAPK signaling pathway.

off_label.title: Oral Administration of Itraconazole Induces M1 Polarization of Tumor-associated Macrophages in Gynecological Cancer.
off_label.summary: Oral antifungal drug itraconazole shifts immune cells in gynecological cancers toward anti-tumor activity.

off_label.title: Targeting mutant VHL-gene results in therapy response in metastatic clear cell carcinoma of rete testis.
off_label.summary: Targeting a mutant VHL gene with belzutifan drug achieved complete remission in a rare metastatic testis cancer patient.

off_label.title: LKB1-AMPK Signaling Pathway in Cardiovascular and Other Diseases.
off_label.summary: The LKB1-AMPK pathway regulates cellular energy and is dysregulated in cardiovascular disease, cancer, diabetes, and neurodegeneration, offering therapeutic targets.

off_label.title: Lidocaine potentiates thermal ablation in cholangiocarcinoma by modulating TRPV6-Driven Ca2+/PI3K/AKT/HSF-1 signaling pathway.
off_label.summary: Lidocaine enhances heat treatment effectiveness in bile duct cancer by blocking a calcium channel that normally helps tumors survive heat stress.

off_label.title: NCAPH promotes immune evasion via inhibiting PD-L1 protein degradation in head and neck squamous cell carcinoma.
off_label.summary: NCAPH protein helps head and neck cancer evade immunity by stabilizing PD-L1; blocking this interaction or degrading NCAPH restores immune response.

off_label.title: Lactic acid promotes an MDSC-like phenotype via HIF1α stabilization with impact on prognosis in renal cell carcinoma.
off_label.summary: Tumor-derived lactate promotes immune-suppressing myeloid cells in kidney cancer, and blocking lactate transport may restore anti-tumor immunity.

off_label.title: SRC at the crossroads of KRAS inhibitor resistance: Mechanisms and therapeutic opportunities.
off_label.summary: SRC protein drives resistance to KRAS inhibitors in lung, colon, and pancreatic cancers; targeting SRC could restore drug effectiveness.

off_label.title: DADA Enhances CD8+ T Cell Stemness to Improve Anti-Tumor Immunity and Immunotherapy Efficacy.
off_label.summary: DADA enhances immune T cells' ability to fight cancer by improving their stem-like properties and boosting immunotherapy effectiveness.

off_label.title: ARID1A Deficiency in Diffuse-Type Gastric Cancer Promotes a Pyrimidine Metabolic Vulnerability.
off_label.summary: ARID1A-deficient gastric cancer has a metabolic weakness that makes it vulnerable to Gemcitabine chemotherapy treatment.

off_label.title: Machine Learning-Informed Nano Co-Assembly Inhibits Fibroblast Activation Protein and Improves Drug Delivery in Fibrotic Tissue.
off_label.summary: Researchers used machine learning to develop nanoparticles that better deliver drugs through fibrotic tissue barriers, improving treatment for fibrosis-related diseases.

off_label.title: Mutant SRSF2-associated impaired erythropoiesis is defined by increased mTORC1 signaling due to FYN missplicing.
off_label.summary: SRSF2 mutations in blood cancers impair red blood cell production by increasing mTORC1 signaling; mTORC1 inhibitors may restore blood cell formation.

off_label.title: Targeting de novo pyrimidine synthesis confers vulnerability to copper-mediated ATR inactivation in PARP inhibitor-resistant ovarian cancer.
off_label.summary: Blocking pyrimidine synthesis combined with copper and PARP inhibitors overcomes drug resistance in ovarian cancer.

off_label.title: Sparsentan for the Treatment of VEGF Signaling Pathway Inhibitor-Associated Proteinuria
off_label.summary: Sparsentan reduces severe protein loss in urine caused by cancer drugs that block blood vessel growth.

off_label.title: A Phase I Trial of Azacitidine and Abatacept in Relapsed or Refractory T-Cell Lymphoma
off_label.summary: Researchers test whether combining azacitidine and abatacept drugs can shrink tumors in people with relapsed or refractory T-cell lymphoma.

off_label.title: IL-1 Receptor Antagonist to Prevent Severe Chimeric Antigen Receptor T-Cell Related Encephalopathy Syndrome
off_label.summary: Anakinra may prevent severe brain inflammation in large B-cell lymphoma patients receiving CAR T-cell therapy.

biomarkers.title: Mass Cytometry Workflow to Achieve High-Dimensional Immunophenotyping in Resource-Limited or Decentralized Environments.
biomarkers.summary: New workflow enables advanced immune testing for lung cancer patients in remote and resource-limited communities without specialized equipment.

biomarkers.title: Successful Management of Suspected Epstein-Barr Virus-Associated Hemophagocytic Lymphohistiocytosis in BRAF-Mutant Cholangiocarcinoma Following Treatment With Immune Checkpoint Inhibitors and BRAF/MEK Inhibitors: A Case Report.
biomarkers.summary: Combination immune and BRAF inhibitor therapy helped treat a rare cholangiocarcinoma case, though it triggered a serious immune side effect requiring careful management.

biomarkers.title: Multiomic characterization of small cell lung cancer: Real-world insights into therapeutic opportunities.
biomarkers.summary: Researchers identified four distinct small cell lung cancer subtypes based on specific proteins, revealing some tumors have more immune cells, offering new treatment targets.

biomarkers.title: Biomarker-directed aptamer panels for diagnosis and differentiation of neuroendocrine tumors.
biomarkers.summary: RNA aptamer panels successfully identified neuroendocrine tumors and distinguished intestinal from pancreatic types using blood biomarkers.

biomarkers.title: A trial of risk-adapted prostate cancer screening in a federally supported health center network serving a high-risk population.
biomarkers.summary: A trial tested risk-adapted prostate cancer screening guidelines in clinics serving high-risk Black communities to improve screening practices and outcomes.

biomarkers.title: Dacomitinib as a First-Line Therapy for Advanced EGFR-Mutated Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer Without Brain Metastases: A Multicenter Retrospective Observational Study.
biomarkers.summary: Dacomitinib shows promise as an effective first-line treatment for advanced lung cancer patients with specific genetic mutations.

biomarkers.title: Dysregulated Peroxiredoxins in Bladder Cancer Are Associated With an Altered Tumour Immune Microenvironment.
biomarkers.summary: High PRDX1 and PRDX6 levels predict poor outcomes in bladder cancer and could help guide immunotherapy treatment strategies.

biomarkers.title: Anti-CD146 Autoantibodies: The First Biologic Markers Associated With Occupational Exposure in Systemic Sclerosis.
biomarkers.summary: Researchers identified anti-CD146 antibodies as a biological marker linking occupational exposure to systemic sclerosis development.

biomarkers.title: Oral Administration of Itraconazole Induces M1 Polarization of Tumor-associated Macrophages in Gynecological Cancer.
biomarkers.summary: Oral antifungal drug itraconazole shifts immune cells in gynecological cancers toward anti-tumor activity.

biomarkers.title: Cost-Effectiveness of PSMA PET/CT as Single Procedure for Diagnosis and Staging High-Grade Prostate Cancer: A Single Center Experience.
biomarkers.summary: PSMA PET/CT imaging effectively diagnoses and stages high-grade prostate cancer in a single procedure, reducing costs compared to traditional multi-step approaches.

biomarkers.title: Prognostic Role of Inflammatory Blood Cell Ratios in Glioblastoma Patients: Insights from a Single-institution Study.
biomarkers.summary: Blood cell ratios may help predict survival outcomes in glioblastoma patients undergoing standard treatment.

biomarkers.title: Physalin A Suppresses Human Oral Squamous Carcinoma Cell Migration and Invasion Through Inhibiting Grb2/Ras and MMP/uPA Signaling Pathways.
biomarkers.summary: Physalin A, a natural compound, reduces oral cancer cell migration and invasion by blocking specific cellular signaling pathways.

biomarkers.title: Chondromyxoid Fibroma: An Updated Review.
biomarkers.summary: Chondromyxoid fibroma is a rare benign bone tumor in young adults; GRM1 gene alterations help diagnose it, with surgery as primary treatment.

biomarkers.title: Methionine Restriction Alone Induces T-cell-mediated Immunotherapy of Osteosarcoma in a Syngeneic Mouse Model.
biomarkers.summary: Restricting methionine alone effectively triggers the immune system to fight osteosarcoma in mice without additional treatments.

biomarkers.title: The Prognostic Role of Baseline and Early Dynamics of Peripheral Blood Cell Ratios in Metastatic Renal Cell Carcinoma Patients Treated With Nivolumab.
biomarkers.summary: Blood cell ratios at treatment start predict survival outcomes in advanced kidney cancer patients receiving nivolumab immunotherapy.

trials.title: Study on the Promotion of Mitochondrial Pathway Apoptosis and Muscle Tenderization in Postmortem Tibetan Sheep Meat by Cold Atmospheric Plasma Treatment.
trials.summary: Cold atmospheric plasma treatment tenderizes Tibetan sheep meat by damaging mitochondria and triggering cell death pathways.

trials.title: Successful Management of Suspected Epstein-Barr Virus-Associated Hemophagocytic Lymphohistiocytosis in BRAF-Mutant Cholangiocarcinoma Following Treatment With Immune Checkpoint Inhibitors and BRAF/MEK Inhibitors: A Case Report.
trials.summary: Combination immune and BRAF inhibitor therapy helped treat a rare cholangiocarcinoma case, though it triggered a serious immune side effect requiring careful management.

trials.summary: A new machine combining X-rays and gamma rays creates sharper radiation doses, potentially improving prostate cancer treatment effectiveness.

trials.summary: Focused radiation therapy shows promise for treating spread anaplastic thyroid cancer when limited metastases develop.

trials.title: Deep Immunophenotyping Reveals a Resilient Tph-ABC Axis in Difficult-to-treat Rheumatoid Arthritis: A Case Report of JAK Inhibitor Failure Complicated by Herpes Zoster and Thrombosis.
trials.summary: A study identifies immune cell types that resist standard treatment in difficult-to-treat rheumatoid arthritis, potentially explaining therapy failures.

trials.title: Effectiveness of a Physician-Pharmacist Collaborative Protocol for Universal Hepatitis B Virus Screening Prior to Chemotherapy in Cancer Patients.
trials.summary: A doctor-pharmacist team protocol successfully prevents hepatitis B reactivation in cancer patients receiving chemotherapy through coordinated screening and management.

trials.title: Immature Peritumoral Tertiary Lymphoid Structures Indicate Poor Prognosis in Pancreatic Ductal Adenocarcinoma After NAC.
trials.summary: Immature immune structures near pancreatic cancer tumors predict worse outcomes for patients receiving chemotherapy before surgery.

trials.title: Concurrent Pemetrexed With EGFR-TKI Slows the Accumulation of De Novo Mutations During In Vitro Exposure.
trials.summary: Combining pemetrexed with EGFR inhibitors slows the development of drug-resistant mutations in lung cancer cells exposed to targeted therapy.

trials.title: Effectiveness of Pembrolizumab Monotherapy for Older Adults With Head and Neck Carcinoma by CPS Status.
trials.summary: Pembrolizumab alone works effectively for older adults with head and neck cancer, even without chemotherapy addition.
